reports.desc: I was contacted by email from Megan Hall, Talent Acquisition Specialist, with Credera Inc by email. They received an application for Order Processing & Data Entry Coordinator position. They offered to move me forward in the interview process by booking a 30 minute interview with Ava Wilson, using Microsoft Teams. I communicated with them only on Microsoft Teams. They then offered me the position with an employment agreement. They had me proceed with the onboarding process through the Credera Secure Employment Enrollment Portal by uploading a signed copy of employment agreement, completed FW4 form, Copy of my State ID, and current mailing address. My social security number was listed on the W4 form. They sent me a check for $3850.12 to deposit into my bank account for office and tech supplies. At this point, I stopped communicating with them and reported it as a scam.
Called the phone number, told them some medical info then they asked for my phone number

Brenner Bakery describes a Rhinebeck NY bakery owned by Hollis and Cathy Brenner who are closing their bakery after 40 years.  It claims to be selling handmade beeswax bread storage bags.  In reality there is no bricks and mortar bakery in Rhinebeck and the cheaply made, mass production bags come from China.  Attached is a photo of the bag shown on the website as what is being ordered/paid for.  The actual bag doesn't remotely resemble the finely crafted bag.  It has a plastic lining and black clips to close it.  Seller would not refund purchase price and credit card company did not classify as fraud despite dramatic differences in website photos.  Out the $34.
